f9a3cef4.raw_request: Request knee MRI for patient P-1001 with 8 weeks failed physical therapy.

retrieved.text: Diagnostic imaging (MRI, CT, PET) is covered when medically necessary and ordered by an in-network provider. Prior authorisation is required.
If a request lacks the clinical documentation needed to assess it, the plan must request additional information before deciding.
Prior authorisation is required for imaging, surgery, bariatric procedures, and specialty drugs.
Physiotherapy is covered up to 20 sessions per plan year with a physician referral.

necessity_findings.reason: Pain persisted 6+ weeks or red flags present.

retrieved.text: Knee MRI is indicated for persistent knee pain lasting 6 weeks or more despite documented conservative management, or immediately following acute severe knee trauma with inability to bear weight.

Knee arthroscopy is indicated for meniscal tears with persistent mechanical symptoms (joint locking, catching, or giving way) after at least 6 weeks of failed conservative care; it is not indicated for degenerative osteoarthritis alone in the absence of mechanical obstruction.
Routine MRI of the lumbar spine is not indicated for acute uncomplicated low back pain lasting under 6 weeks without documented red-flag features.
Physical therapy is medically indicated following orthopedic surgery, acute musculoskeletal trauma, or documented functional deficit causing significant limitation in activities of daily living.

clause_text.PLAN-2.1: Diagnostic imaging (MRI, CT, PET) is covered when medically necessary and ordered by an in-network provider. Prior authorisation is required.
clause_text.PLAN-7.1: Prior authorisation is required for imaging, surgery, bariatric procedures, and specialty drugs.
clause_text.GL-MRI-3.1: Lumbar spine MRI is indicated for low back pain accompanied by documented red-flag features (severe or progressive neurological deficit, suspected cauda equina syndrome, suspected spinal infection, or malignancy), or when persistent pain lasts 6 weeks or more despite documented adherence to conservative therapy (physiotherapy, medication).

Re: Pre-authorisation request, patient P-1001 (Case f9a3cef4)
Provider: 

Dear Provider,

We are pleased to confirm that pre-authorisation for knee MRI has been APPROVED.

Basis for this decision:
  - PLAN-2.1: Diagnostic imaging (MRI, CT, PET) is covered when medically necessary and ordered by an in-network provider. Prior authorisation is required.
  - PLAN-7.1: Prior authorisation is required for imaging, surgery, bariatric procedures, and specialty drugs.
  - GL-MRI-3.1: Lumbar spine MRI is indicated for low back pain accompanied by documented red-flag features (severe or progressive neurological deficit, suspected cauda equina syndrome, suspected spinal infection, or malignancy), or when persistent pain lasts 6 weeks or more despite documented adherence to conservative therapy (physiotherapy, medication).

You may appeal this decision or resubmit with further documentation.

Sincerely,
SynthCare Utilisation Management
